map.粒子初始化：速度分量 = (random − 0.5) × 速度 × 2；尺寸: Particle initialization: velocity component = (random − 0.5) × speed × 2; size = base size × (0.5 + random × 0.5); lifetime = base lifetime × (0.7 + random × 0.3) (a base lifetime of 0 is recorded as −1 meaning infinite); angle = random × 2π, angular velocity = (random − 0.5) × 0.02. Update: vy gains gravity × 0.1 each frame; mouse interaction applies a force of (120 − distance) ÷ 120 × 0.8 within 120 px to attract or repel; velocity is multiplied by 0.99 damping each frame; lifetime decreases to 0 and the particle is removed, and beyond the ±50 px boundary finite-lifetime particles are removed while infinite-lifetime ones wrap around from the opposite side. Drawing: opacity = remaining lifetime ÷ initial lifetime (1 for infinite lifetime), glow blur = size × 2; connecting lines only apply when the particle count < 300, with line opacity = (1 − distance ÷ link distance) × 0.4
